mainEntity.name: How long does a typical paint color consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical paint color consultation can range from 1 to 2 hours, depending on the size of your home or the number of rooms you wish to address. For larger projects or those requiring extensive discussion, it might take longer. Our goal is to ensure you feel confident and satisfied with the color choices before concluding the session.
